settings.question: Can it help with low stamina or performance worries?
settings.answer: Yes. The men's check covers stamina, energy, stress and performance, and a doctor reviews your answers privately before suggesting anything. Many of these concerns are common and treatable.

settings.question: How soon will I see results?
settings.answer: Most people notice first changes in 4 to 6 weeks. A full plan usually runs 3 months, adjusted at each monthly check-in. Results vary from person to person.

settings.question: How do I pay for a care kit?
settings.answer: Confirm your order with just ₹50 and pay the rest when your kit arrives, or pay the full amount online.

settings.question: Will anyone know what I ordered?
settings.answer: No. Your kit comes in a plain box with nothing printed on it about what is inside, and only your doctor sees your answers.

settings.question: Is it safe to combine Ayurveda, Homeopathy and Allopathy?
settings.answer: Your doctors plan your care together, so the parts of your plan are chosen to work with each other. Always tell your doctor about any medicines you already take.

settings.question: How long does delivery take?
settings.answer: Usually 3 to 5 days, depending on where you live.
